1. Design, develop, test, and maintain software modules and services

1. Merancang, mengembangkan, menguji, dan memelihara modul serta layanan perangkat lunak.

6. Memantau kinerja aplikasi dan mendukung penyelesaian masalah pada lingkungan produksi.

8. Mendukung perbaikan berkelanjutan, refactoring, dan peningkatan teknis sistem.

• Minimal S1 Teknik Komputer, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.

• Berpengalaman menggunakan Business Intelligence tools seperti Power BI, Qlik Sense, Tableau, atau sejenisnya.
• Menguasai Python dan/atau Node.js serta memahami integrasi dan komunikasi API.
• Memahami prinsip visualisasi data, desain dashboard, dan pengembangan data pipeline.
• Memahami metodologi pengembangan proyek IT (SDLC, Agile/Scrum, atau Waterfall) serta familiar dengan Jira, Confluence, Figma, atau tools sejenis.
• Memiliki kemampuan analitis, problem solving, komunikasi, dan stakeholder management yang baik serta bersedia ditempatkan di Surabaya.

1. Area Surveillance and Patrolling

Conduct routine patrols throughout the workplace (both indoor and outdoor) according to the designated schedule to preempt potential security threats.

Monitor electronic security systems, including CCTV cameras, fire alarms, and automated gates (if applicable).

Ensure all doors, gates, and windows are securely locked after operational hours.

2. Access Control and Inspection

Perform screening, body checking, or vehicle inspections for employees, visitors, and vendors entering or leaving the company premises.

Direct visitors to sign the logbook and issue visitor badges accordingly.

Manage vehicle traffic in the parking lot and ensure all vehicles are parked neatly and safely.

3. Enforcement of Discipline, Biosecurity, and OHS Procedures

Ensure everyone on the company premises complies with regulations, Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) rules, and specialized protocols (such as sanitation/biosecurity procedures in farm or factory environments).

Prevent unauthorized personnel from entering restricted areas.

4. Emergency Response and Reporting

Act as the first responder in handling emergency situations, such as fires, criminal acts (theft/trespassing), workplace accidents, or natural disasters.

Administer first aid or promptly coordinate with relevant external authorities (Fire Department, Local Police, Hospital) during emergencies.

Maintain daily logs in the Security Shift Logbook and prepare written Incident Reports for the Shift Leader (Danru) or Chief Security in the event of specific incidents.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
